title: Psalms 142
summary: Knowest - So as to direct me to it. My path - What paths I should chuse whereby I might escape.

inlines.v: Knowest - So as to direct me to it. My path - What paths I should chuse whereby I might escape.
Right - hand - The place where the patron or assistant used to stand.

Prison - Set me at liberty. Compass - Shall flock to me from all parts, to rejoice and bless God with me and for me. CHAPT.CXLIII David complains and prays for pardon and help, ver. 1 - 12. A psalm of David.
